field.name: requiresRegistration
field.comment: true: only the registered users can vote; false: anyone can

field.name: showResults
field.comment: true: a visitor that has voted is shown customMessage instead of the results, despite what the name of this field says; false: the results are displayed

field.name: customMessage
field.comment: The text displayed to a visitor that has voted (used if showResults is true)

field.name: optionName
field.comment: The text of the answer, displayed beside its radio button

field.name: displayOrder
field.comment: The position of the answer in the survey, starting from zero

field.name: optionID
field.comment: The ID of the answer that was voted

field.name: uID
field.comment: The ID of the user that voted (0 or NULL: nobody was logged in)

field.name: cID
field.comment: The ID of the page the vote was cast from, which tells the stacks apart from the pages displaying them

field.name: ipAddress
field.comment: The IP address the vote came from, which keeps the visitors that are not logged in from voting twice
